Rashi on Nedarim 27b:1:1.hebrew: דאי הוי ידע - בשעת התנאי דמיית בתוך הזמן, לאלתר גמר ויהיב גיטא מעכשיו, הלכך הוי גט, ולהכי גמר בלביה למיהוי גט. אבל האי, אי הוה ידע דאתניס, לא הוה מבטל זכוותיה ולא גמר ומקני:
Rashi on Nedarim 27b:1:1.english: For had he known - at the time of the condition that he would die within the [specified] time, he would immediately have finalized [his decision] and given the bill of divorce [to take effect] from now; therefore it is a [valid] bill of divorce, and for this reason he resolved in his heart that it should be a [valid] bill of divorce. However, [in] this [case], had he known that he would be prevented by unavoidable circumstances, he would not have nullified his rights and would not have finalized [his decision] to transfer [them].

Rashi on Nedarim 27b:2:1.hebrew: ואמר להו שמואל לא שמיה מתייא - אע"ג דאניס. והא מינס אניס, ולא ליהוי גיטא:
Rashi on Nedarim 27b:2:1.english: And Shmuel said to them: It is not considered an arrival - Even though he was impeded by circumstances beyond his control. [The Gemara asks:] But he was impeded by circumstances beyond his control, so let it not be a bill of divorce!

Rashi on Nedarim 27b:3:1.hebrew: דלמא אונסא דמיגליא שאני - ומעברא אונסא דמיגליא הוא, דזימנין דלא משתכחא בהאי גיסא, ומבעיא ליה לאסוקי אדעתיה (ודלמא אסיק אדעתיה), ואפי' הכי לא התנה. משום הכי, אי מיתניס בהאי זמן, אמר גמר ומקני דליהוי גט אפילו עיכבו שום אונס, אבל בעלמא אי איתניס, פטור:
Rashi on Nedarim 27b:3:1.english: Perhaps [a case of] an unavoidable circumstance that is apparent is different - And a ferry is an apparent unavoidable circumstance, for at times it is not found on this side [of the river], and he needed to bring [this] to mind (and perhaps he [indeed] brought it to mind), and even so he did not stipulate [against it]. Therefore, if he is prevented by an unavoidable circumstance at that time, we say he fully resolved [to effect the divorce] so that it should be a [valid] bill of divorce even if some unavoidable circumstance delayed him; however, in general, if he is prevented by an unavoidable circumstance, he is exempt.

Rashi on Nedarim 27b:4:1.hebrew: ולרב הונא - דאמר בטלן זכוותיה, אמאי? הא אסמכתא הוא, דברים בעלמא, וסמך על דעתו כסבור שהוא יכול לבא בזמנו, להכי קאמר הכי, ואסמכתא לא קניא:
Rashi on Nedarim 27b:4:1.english: And according to Rav Huna - who said [that] his [documents of] rights are voided, why? Behold, it is an asmakhta [an inconclusive commitment] — mere words, and he relied upon his own judgment, thinking that he would be able to come at his [appointed] time, [and] therefore he said this — and an asmakhta does not effect acquisition.

Rashi on Nedarim 27b:4:2.english: Here [it is] different - For this reason, it effects acquisition.

Rashi on Nedarim 27b:4:3.hebrew: דאתפיס זכותיה לב"ד - דכגבוי דמי, ולא הוה אסמכתא:
Rashi on Nedarim 27b:4:3.english: Because he deposited his [documents for a] favorable verdict with the court - For it is considered as [already] collected, and it is not an asmakhta.

Rashi on Nedarim 27b:5:1.hebrew: מי שפרע מקצת חובו והשליש את שטרו - שהניח השטר שהיה לו לבעל חוב עליו ביד נאמן, ואמר לו: אם איני פורע החוב מכאן עד ל' יום, תן לו שטרו למלוה, ויחזור ויגבה בו כל מה שכתוב בו בתחילה:
Rashi on Nedarim 27b:5:1.english: One who repaid part of his debt and deposited his document with a third party - [This means] that he placed the document that the creditor held against him in the hand of a trustee, and said to him: If I do not pay the debt from now until thirty days, give his document to the lender, and he will go back and collect with it all that is written in it originally.

Rashi on Nedarim 27b:6:1.english: And he did not give - And he did not pay.

Rashi on Nedarim 27b:6:2.hebrew: רבי יוסי אומר יתן - השליש השטר למלוה, ואע"ג דאסמכתא היא, דסבור היה לפרוע באותו הזמן, קנה המלוה את השטר:
Rashi on Nedarim 27b:6:2.english: Rabbi Yosei says: He should give - The third party [should give] the document to the creditor; and even though it is an asmakhta, because he had thought to pay at that time, the creditor acquires the document.

Rashi on Nedarim 27b:6:3.hebrew: אין הלכה וכו' - הא הכא, אע"ג דאתפיס השטר ביד [השליש], הויא אסמכתא ולא קניא לטעמיה דרב:
Rashi on Nedarim 27b:6:3.english: The halakha is not, etc. - Here, even though he deposited the document in the hand of [the third party], it is an asmakhta and does not effect acquisition, according to Rav's reasoning.

Rashi on Nedarim 27b:7:1.hebrew: שאני הכא דאמר ליבטלן זכותיה - שלא יהא בהן ממש, דזהו חמור מ"תן לו שטרו":
Rashi on Nedarim 27b:7:1.english: It is different here, because he said, "Let his rights be void" - That there should be no substance to them, for this is more stringent than [saying,] "Give him his document."

Rashi on Nedarim 27b:8:1.hebrew: והלכתא אסמכתא קניא - ואע"ג דלא מתפיס:
Rashi on Nedarim 27b:8:1.english: And the halakha [is that] an asmakhta effects acquisition - Even though he did not deposit [his documents with the court].

Rashi on Nedarim 27b:8:2.hebrew: והוא דלא אניס - באונסא דמוכחא לאינשי, כי האי דלעיל דפסקיה מעברא:
Rashi on Nedarim 27b:8:2.english: And this is [only] if he was not impeded - By an unavoidable circumstance that is evident to people, like that [case] above where the ferry cut him off.

Rashi on Nedarim 27b:8:3.english: And this is [only] if they effected an acquisition from him - so that he will not retract.

Rashi on Nedarim 27b:8:4.hebrew: ובב"ד חשוב - שיהא מומחה לרבים. וכל הני תלת מילי בעינן בה, דאי הוה חד בלא אידך לא קני, אלא כולהו ג' בעינן — דלא אניס, וקנין, ובב"ד חשוב:
Rashi on Nedarim 27b:8:4.english: And in an eminent court - That it be recognized as expert by the public. And we require all three of these things for it, for if there were one without the other, it does not effect acquisition; rather, we require all three — that he was not impeded, and an act of acquisition, and in an eminent court.

Rashi on Nedarim 27b:9:1.hebrew: להרגין - שהוא הורג על עסקי ממון, שאם בא להורגו יכול לדור על זה שהוא של תרומה, ויאמר: נדר זה עלי אם אינו של תרומה, אע"פ שאינו של תרומה, כדי שלא יטלם, לפי שיש חיוב מיתה לזו והנדר מותר. והיינו נמי נדרי אונסין:
Rashi on Nedarim 27b:9:1.english: To murderers - For he kills over monetary matters; for if he comes to kill him, he may take a vow concerning this [produce] that it is terumah, and say, "This vow is upon me if it is not terumah," even though it is not terumah, so that he will not take them, because there is a risk of death in this [situation], and the vow is permitted. And this too is [an example of] vows of coercion.

Rashi on Nedarim 27b:9:2.english: And to robbers [charamin] - [Referring to one] who is a mere bandit who does not kill.

Rashi on Nedarim 27b:9:3.hebrew: ולמוכסים - נוטל מכס המלך, ורוצה ליטול פירותיו בע"כ:
Rashi on Nedarim 27b:9:3.english: And to tax collectors - [One who] collects the king's tax and wants to take his produce against his will.

Rashi on Nedarim 27b:9:4.hebrew: אף על פי שאינן של תרומה - יכול לידור שהן של תרומה כדי שלא יטלם, ומתני' לא זו אף זו קתני:
Rashi on Nedarim 27b:9:4.english: Even though they are not of teruma - He may vow that they are of teruma so that he will not take them, and the Mishnah teaches [this in the style of] "not only this, but even that."

Rashi on Nedarim 27b:9:5.english: With anything one may vow - to them.

Tosafot on Nedarim 27b:4:1.hebrew: ולרב הונא אסמכתא היא - הוה מצי למימר דס"ל לרב הונא דאסמכתא קניא, אלא ניחא ליה ליישב רב הונא אליבא דהלכתא, דר"נ פסיק בסמוך כרבי יהודה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 27b:4:1.english: And according to Rav Huna, it is an asmakhta - [The Gemara] could have said that Rav Huna holds that an asmakhta effects acquisition, but it prefers to reconcile Rav Huna['s view] in accordance with the halakhah, as Rav Nachman rules shortly [hereafter] in accordance with Rabbi Yehudah.

Tosafot on Nedarim 27b:7:1.hebrew: שאני הכא דאמר ליבטלו זכוותיה - פי': מטעם הודאה, כדפרישית לעיל:
Tosafot on Nedarim 27b:7:1.english: "It is different here, because he said that his rights should be void" - Explanation: [It is] by reason of an admission, as I explained above.

Tosafot on Nedarim 27b:8:1.hebrew: והלכתא אסמכתא קניא וכו' - לכאורה מיירי דאמר בלא מעכשיו, דאילו אמר מעכשיו מועיל שפיר בלא קנין בב"ד חשוב, כדמוכח פר' איזהו נשך (ב"מ דף סז). ומיהו אור"י דע"כ הכא מיירי דאמר מעכשיו, מדאמר "דקנו מיניה", וסתם קנין בסודר, וקנין סודר בלא מעכשיו אינו מועיל כלום, כדאמר לקמן פרק השותפין (נדרים דף מח:): "דהא הדר סודרא למרא" — פירוש: כשחל הקנין אינו מועיל כלום, כגון אם אמר לאחר ל' יום, א"כ אין הקנין עד לאחר ל' יום, וכבר הדרא סודרא למריה. וא"כ ע"כ מיירי הכא דאמר מעכשיו, ואפ"ה קאמר דדוקא בב"ד חשוב קנו מיניה, אבל בלא קנין בב"ד חשוב לא מועיל מעכשיו בלא אסמכתא. והא דמשמע באיזהו נשך דמעכשיו מועיל בלא ב"ד חשוב — י"ל דאסמכתא דהתם שאני, לפי שהוא דרך מכר, דמיירי שהלוהו על שדהו ואמר ליה "אם אין אתה נותן לי מכאן ועד שלש שנים הרי הוא שלי". אור"ת שלכך נהגו לאסוף כל בני העיר בשעת שידוכין, היינו כי היכי דליהוו ב"ד חשוב ולא יהא ערבון אסמכתא. ואין נראה לר"י, שהרי כמה פעמים אין שם אלא קרובים, וגם אין מתקיים לשום קיום תנאי. לכ"נ דלענין ערבון של שידוכין נראה דהכי הוא, דקני שפיר בלא מעכשיו וגם בלא קנין ב"ד חשוב, דלפי שמתבייש ביותר מי שחוזר בו לא חשוב אסמכתא כלל, דלאו גוזמא הוא מה שמתנה עמו בערבון אם יחזור בו, דדמי בושתו הוא, ולא גזרינן כמו "אם אוביר ולא איעביד אשלם במיטבא":
Tosafot on Nedarim 27b:8:1.english: And the halakha is that an asmakhta effects acquisition, etc. - On the surface, [this is referring to a case] where he said [the stipulation] without [saying] "from now" (me'akhshav), for if he had said "from now," it would be fully effective even without an act of acquisition in an eminent court, as is proven in the chapter [entitled] Eizehu Neshekh (Bava Metzia 67). However, Rabbeinu Yitzchak says that perforce here [the Gemara] is speaking of a case where he did say "from now," since it says "that they effected an acquisition from him," and an unspecified act of acquisition is [performed] with a kerchief (kinyan sudar), and an acquisition with a kerchief without "from now" is completely ineffective, as [the Gemara] says later in the chapter [entitled] Hashutafin (Nedarim 48b): "For the kerchief has already returned to its owner." Explanation: When the acquisition [is supposed to] take effect, it is completely ineffective—for example, if he said "after thirty days," then the acquisition does not [take place] until after thirty days, and by then the kerchief has already returned to its owner. Therefore, perforce [the Gemara] here is speaking of a case where he said "from now," and even so it says that specifically in an eminent court [where] they effected an acquisition from him [is it valid], whereas without an acquisition in an eminent court, "from now" is not effective [to overcome] an asmakhta. And as for what is implied in Eizehu Neshekh, that "from now" is effective without an eminent court — one can say that the asmakhta there is different, because it is in the manner of a sale, since it is speaking of one who lent [money] to another on [the security of] his field and said to him, "If you do not pay me between now and three years [from now], it is mine." Rabbeinu Tam says that the reason it is customary to gather all the townspeople at the time of betrothal arrangements (shiddukhin) is so that they will constitute an eminent court and the forfeit-deposit (eravon) will not be an asmakhta. But this does not appear [correct] to Rabbeinu Yitzchak, for many times there are only relatives present, and furthermore it is not executed for the purpose of formalizing a condition. Therefore, it appears that regarding a betrothal forfeit-deposit, it seems that this is how it is: it effects acquisition fully even without "from now" and also without an acquisition in an eminent court; for since one who retracts is exceedingly embarrassed, it is not considered an asmakhta at all, as what he stipulates with him regarding the forfeit-deposit if he retracts is not an exaggeration (guzma), since it is compensation for his embarrassment, and we do not decree [it invalid] like [the case of] "If I leave [the field] fallow and do not work it, I will pay from the best [produce]."

Tosafot on Nedarim 27b:9:1.hebrew: נודרים להרגין - הורגים נפשות על עסקי ממון; ולחרמים קילי טפי, וזו אף זו קתני:
Tosafot on Nedarim 27b:9:1.english: One may take a vow to murderers - [Those who] kill people over monetary matters; and [the case of] robbers [ḥaramim] is less severe, and [the Mishnah] teaches "this, and even this" [i.e., not only in the more severe case, but even in the less severe one].

Tosafot on Nedarim 27b:9:2.hebrew: שהם של תרומה - וא"ת: התינח הרגין וחרמים שגוזלין ממון, ועתה כשאמר להם שהם של תרומה לא יגזלו אותם, דאינם מתכוונים כ"א לגזול ולא לאיסורא, כיון שאינה ראויה לאכילה לזרים; אבל מוכסין — מאי אהני? לעולם ישאל המכס. וי"ל: שלא היו רגילים ליקח מכס זה ממוליכי תרומה לכהנים:
Tosafot on Nedarim 27b:9:2.english: "[That] they are of teruma" - And if you will ask: This makes sense regarding murderers and robbers, who steal money, and now, when he says to them that they are of teruma, they will not steal them, because they intend only to steal and not [to commit] a prohibition, since it is not fit for consumption by non-priests; but [regarding] tax collectors — what does it avail? He will still demand the tax. And one can say: they were not accustomed to take this tax from those who bring teruma to the priests:
